notes: s014 Ἑτοιμάσατε → Make ye ready heads on ready: ἑτοιμάζω is denominal from ἕτοιμος, so rule 66's closing clause and rule 91 both put the head on the stem word, as rule 17 does for make straight.
s019 and s018 are separate Greek tokens and correctly split, so the second Make and straight are not one frame.
s005 λόγων takes the supplied determiner under rule 58, and s020 is emptied by the possessive his under rule 20.
